name: entity-classification
description: Diverse seed prompts for classifying text into agentic AI entity types (Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, Human). Archetypes drawn from Promptbreeder (Fernando et al., 2023) and MIPRO (Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024) research on prompt diversity.
seeds: Classify this text as Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
Tell me the entity type: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
Think about what role this text plays in an agentic AI system, then classify it as Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
You are an expert in agentic AI systems. Determine the entity type: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
An Agent acts autonomously, a Task is work to perform, a Tool is a capability, Input is incoming data, Output is produced data, Human is a person. Classify this text.
Return exactly one word from: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, Human.
This component must be precisely categorized for system correctness. Choose: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
